subject: anatomy
title: Vertebral column
summary: The flexible column of vertebrae that supports the head and trunk and surrounds the spinal cord.

subject: anatomy
title: Spinal cord
summary: The part of the central nervous system inside the vertebral column, linking the brain with the spinal nerves.

subject: chemistry
title: Water
summary: H₂O: a bent molecule whose polarity explains much of its behaviour as a liquid and a solvent.

subject: chemistry
title: Electron-pair geometry and molecular structure (VSEPR)
summary: Electron pairs around a central atom spread as far apart as possible; the shape named after the atoms alone is the molecular structure.

subject: physics
title: Position in free fall
summary: The height of an object moving only under gravity, as a function of time, when up is taken as positive.

subject: mathematics
title: Power rule for derivatives
summary: The derivative of xⁿ is n·xⁿ⁻¹.

subject: biology
title: Enzyme catalytic cycle
summary: An enzyme binds its substrate at the active site, lowers the activation energy of the reaction, releases the products and is ready to act again.

subject: biology
title: Michaelis–Menten equation
summary: The initial rate of an enzyme-catalysed reaction as a function of substrate concentration.

subject: biology
title: Substrate needed for 90% of Vmax
summary: Rearranging the Michaelis–Menten equation to find the [S] that gives a chosen fraction of the maximum rate.
